file_stem: RWB TE 003 Types and contract tests from the API specification
title: Types and contract tests from the API specification
goal: Generate server interfaces and TS types from the OpenAPI file, with a contract and 403 test each
why: The API spec (79 operations) is the single source of truth. Code cannot drift from it, and every endpoint is proven to refuse the wrong role.
ace_note: No ACE read. Tests use an in-memory database and synthetic fixtures.

reads.note: role rights used by the 403 tests

stores: api/recovery-api.yaml (OpenAPI 3.1, base /api/recovery/v1, x-module, x-capability, x-first-release); build report
rules: BR1: the OpenAPI file is the only source of endpoints
BR2: every operation has operationId, x-module, x-capability, x-first-release, Problem schema
BR3: operations of the current release must be implemented and pass
BR4: a wrong role gets 403 MSG-P4-002
risks: Response schema drift -> 'contract broken' naming the JSON path
Endpoint skips its access check -> 'access not enforced'
example: getAdminJobs with no controller -> 'has no implementation'
